primary_result: Official FineWeb2 first-rows access returned 44 unique spa_Latn/train records, all CC-MAIN-2013-20, proving source existence and schema without promoting storage-order rows to training.
secondary_result: Independent review found FineWeb English plus FineWeb2 French/Spanish is an official companion design but not one preprocessing pipeline; retained probes lack complete immutable retrieval provenance.
claim_scope: Training-source qualification only; no tokenizer training, fairness score, method comparison, confirmation result, original-paper reproduction or legal opinion.
next_action: Build immutable shard manifests at the fixed commits, freeze hash-ranked sampling and matched budgets, then run result-blind GlobalVoices URL/domain and text decontamination before any formal trilingual training.
